experiments.name: idle
experiments.description: No player. New expiry (unsold offers don't give demand back). Settings from the assets.

experiments.name: idle_old_expiry
experiments.description: No player, old expiry (expired offers give demand back).

experiments.name: hold
experiments.description: Buys up paintings weeks 20-45 (£1000) and keeps them to the end. New expiry.

experiments.name: dump
experiments.description: Buys up paintings weeks 20-45 (£1000), dumps them from week 70. New expiry.
